[LLM] Docker daemon plugin install/enable event from non-admin context (CVE-2026-44848) Installation Medium
Surfaces dockerd syslog entries recording plugin pull/install/enable operations. Combined with UC1 (HTTP) and UC2 (process), this is the daemon-side proof of plugin registration and remains useful on hosts that do not run EDR but ship dockerd journald/syslog to the SIEM. [LLM] n8n host inventory hunt — surface vulnerable instances < 1.123.43 / 2.20.7 / 2.22.1 Reconnaissance Medium
Hunt for hosts running n8n (Node.js parent process or n8n-nodes-base in cmdline) so SOC can cross-reference patched-version state against CVE-2026-44791. This is asset-surface enumeration for the n8n RCE patch bypass — runs read-only and identifies hosts to escalate to vulnerability management. Rationale: Article explicitly names affected packages npm:n8n with version ranges <1.123.43 / 2.20.7 / 2.22.1 and lists NODES_EXCLUDE=n8n-nodes-base.xml as the only workaround. The 'n8n' string in node.exe cmdline is the canonical fingerprint of an n8n instance running on a host — no Defender TVM signature exists for npm packages so process-telemetry is the only practical asset hunt. [LLM] n8n Node.js parent spawning OS shell — post-exploit RCE indicator for CVE-2026-44791 Exploitation High
Detects the realised RCE outcome of the XML-node prototype-pollution patch bypass: an n8n Node.js process (commandline references n8n / n8n-nodes-base) spawning cmd/powershell/sh/bash with download, base64, reverse-shell, or temp-directory cmdline hallmarks. Article states 'when combined with other nodes, this could lead to RCE on the n8n host' — this catches that exact host-side execution shape. Rationale: Article: 'When combined with other nodes, this could lead to RCE on the n8n host.' n8n runs as a Node.js process; the prototype-pollution → RCE chain manifests as the Node parent spawning an OS shell with attacker-controlled cmdline. Parent fingerprint = node + n8n in cmdline (high-precision asset filter). Child = shell binary. Cmdline tokens = the standard reverse-shell / download cradle vocabulary from public n8n CVE-2026-44789/44790/44791 trio writeups (cross-checked against the CyberSecurityNews coverage that catalogs the trio). Cross-checked against: • https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-hqr4-h3xv-9m3r • https://cybersecuritynews.com/n8n-rce-vulnerabilities/

Data sourcesEndpoint.Processes
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe","node")
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("n8n","n8n-nodes-base")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","sh","bash","dash","zsh","ksh")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("curl ","wget ","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX","Invoke-Expression","base64 ","-EncodedCommand","/tmp/","%TEMP%","bash -i","nc -e","perl -e","python -c")
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)/dev/tcp/"
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\bnc\b.*\b-l\b"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
let Lookback = 7d;
let ShellChildren = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","sh","bash","dash","zsh","ksh"]);
let SusTokens = dynamic(["curl ","wget ","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX","Invoke-Expression","base64 ","-EncodedCommand","/tmp/","%TEMP%","bash -i","nc -e","perl -e","python -c"]);
union isfuzzy=true
(SecurityEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
  | where EventID == 4688
  | where ParentProcessName has "\\node.exe"
  | extend ChildBin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
  | where ChildBin in (ShellChildren)
  | where CommandLine has_any (SusTokens) or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)/dev/tcp/"
  | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = TargetUserName,
            ParentCmd = ParentProcessName, ChildImage = NewProcessName, ChildCmd = CommandLine),
(ImProcessCreate
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
  | where ParentProcessName has "node"
  | where ParentProcessCommandLine has_any ("n8n","n8n-nodes-base")
  | extend ChildBin = tolower(tostring(split(ActingProcessName,"/")[-1]))
  | where ChildBin in (ShellChildren)
  | where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (SusTokens) or ActingProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)/dev/tcp/"
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer = DvcHostname, Account = ActorUsername,
            ParentCmd = ParentProcessCommandLine, ChildImage = ActingProcessName, ChildCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
title: n8n Node.js Parent Spawning OS Shell with Download or Reverse-Shell Tokens (CVE-2026-44791)
id: 3b1c1b5a-7d2e-4a48-9f30-2c4be6f5d911
status: experimental
description: Detects post-exploitation of n8n CVE-2026-44791 (XML node prototype pollution patch bypass) where an n8n Node.js parent spawns a shell with download, base64-decode, reverse-shell or temp-directory command-line tokens — the realised RCE outcome.
references:
    - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-wrwr-h859-xh2r
    - https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-hqr4-h3xv-9m3r
    - https://cybersecuritynews.com/n8n-rce-vulnerabilities/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/19
tags:
    - attack.t1190
    - attack.t1059.001
    - attack.t1059.004
    - attack.t1505.003
logsource:
    category: process_creation
detection:
    parent:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\node.exe'
            - '/node'
        ParentCommandLine|contains:
            - 'n8n'
            - 'n8n-nodes-base'
    child_shell:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\cmd.exe'
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
            - '/sh'
            - '/bash'
            - '/dash'
            - '/zsh'
            - '/ksh'
    suspicious_args:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'curl '
            - 'wget '
            - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
            - 'IEX'
            - 'Invoke-Expression'
            - 'base64 '
            - '-EncodedCommand'
            - '/tmp/'
            - '%TEMP%'
            - 'bash -i'
            - 'nc -e'
            - '/dev/tcp/'
            - 'perl -e'
            - 'python -c'
    condition: parent and child_shell and suspicious_args
falsepositives:
    - Workflows that intentionally use the n8n 'Execute Command' node to run a curl/wget/scripted shell step (validate against the workflow inventory)
    - SRE debugging that runs ad-hoc commands inside the n8n container
level: high

[LLM] n8n workflow API request body containing JS prototype pollution tokens (CVE-2026-44789) Exploitation High
Hunts for HTTP requests to the n8n workflow/execution API whose body or query string contains JavaScript prototype-pollution sentinels (`__proto__`, `constructor.prototype`, `__defineGetter__`) targeting the HTTP Request node pagination parameter. This is the article-specific pre-exploit signal for CVE-2026-44789. Rationale: Pivots on the exact prototype-pollution sentinels (`__proto__`, `constructor.prototype`, `__defineGetter__`) named in CWE-1321 / GHSA-c8xv-5998-g76h, scoped to the n8n REST/webhook URL surface where the pagination parameter is parsed. Cross-checked against GitHub GHSA advisory, Endor Labs write-up, and Cybersecurity News reporting. Cross-checked against: • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c8xv-5998-g76h • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-44789 • https://www.endorlabs.com/learn/ • https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1321.html
ATT&CKT1190 T1059.007
Data sourcesWeb.Web
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let PollutionTokens = dynamic(["__proto__", "constructor.prototype", "__defineGetter__", "prototype[", "%5F%5Fproto%5F%5F", "%5Fproto%5F"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where RemotePort in (5678, 443, 80) or LocalPort in (5678, 443, 80)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("node.exe", "n8n.exe")
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "n8n"
| where RemoteUrl has_any (PollutionTokens)
    or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (PollutionTokens)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, LocalPort, RemotePort,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| order by Timestamp desc
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let PollutionTokens = dynamic(["__proto__", "constructor.prototype", "__defineGetter__", "prototype[", "%5F%5Fproto%5F%5F", "%5Fproto%5F"]);
let IISHits = W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where csUriStem has_any ("/rest/workflows", "/rest/executions", "/webhook")
    | where csUriQuery has_any (PollutionTokens) or csUriStem has_any (PollutionTokens)
    | project TimeGenerated, Host = Computer, ClientIP = cIP, User = csUserName,
              Method = csMethod, Uri = csUriStem, Query = csUriQuery, UA = csUserAgent,
              Source = "W3CIISLog";
let CSLHits = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RequestURL has_any ("/rest/workflows", "/rest/executions", "/webhook")
    | where RequestURL has_any (PollutionTokens) or Message has_any (PollutionTokens)
    | project TimeGenerated, Host = DestinationHostName, ClientIP = SourceIP,
              User = SourceUserName, Method = RequestMethod, Uri = RequestURL,
              Query = RequestContext, UA = RequestClientApplication,
              Source = "CommonSecurityLog";
let WebHits = ImWebSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Url has_any ("/rest/workflows", "/rest/executions", "/webhook")
    | where Url has_any (PollutionTokens) or UrlOriginal has_any (PollutionTokens)
    | project TimeGenerated, Host = DvcHostname, ClientIP = SrcIpAddr,
              User = SrcUsername, Method = HttpMethod, Uri = Url,
              Query = UrlOriginal, UA = HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent,
              Source = "ImWebSession";
union isfuzzy=true IISHits, CSLHits, WebHits
| order by TimeGenerated desc
title: n8n HTTP Request Node Pagination Prototype Pollution Tokens (CVE-2026-44789)
id: 7e3b2a4c-1f5d-4e9a-8c7f-2d6b3a1c4e8f
description: Detects HTTP requests to n8n workflow/execution/webhook API endpoints whose URI or query string carries JavaScript prototype-pollution sentinel tokens used to exploit CVE-2026-44789 in the HTTP Request node pagination handler.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c8xv-5998-g76h
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-44789
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/20
tags:

  - attack.t1190
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.007
  - cve.2026.44789
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_uri:
    cs-uri-stem|contains:
      - '/rest/workflows'
      - '/rest/executions'
      - '/webhook'
  selection_payload:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - '__proto__'
      - 'constructor.prototype'
      - '__defineGetter__'
      - 'prototype['
      - '%5F%5Fproto%5F%5F'
  condition: selection_uri and selection_payload
falsepositives:
  - JavaScript prototype-pollution scanners (Burp, Acunetix, Nessus) run by internal security teams
  - Legitimate developer use of `__proto__` as a literal string in a workflow body (rare)
level: high
(source:windows.sysmon OR source:nginx OR source:apache OR source:aws.alb OR source:cloudflare) (@http.url:(*"/rest/workflows"* OR *"/rest/executions"* OR *"/webhook"*) OR @url:(*"/rest/workflows"* OR *"/rest/executions"* OR *"/webhook"*)) (@http.url:(*__proto__* OR *constructor.prototype* OR *__defineGetter__* OR *%5F%5Fproto%5F%5F*) OR @url:(*__proto__* OR *constructor.prototype* OR *__defineGetter__*) OR @http.url_details.queryString:(*__proto__* OR *constructor.prototype*))
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/node(\.exe)?$/i
| (regex("--inspect", field=CommandLine) OR regex("n8n", field=CommandLine))
| (regex("__proto__", field=CommandLine) OR regex("constructor\.prototype", field=CommandLine) OR regex("__defineGetter__", field=CommandLine))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
WEB

[LLM] Post-exploit RCE: node.js (n8n) spawning shell or scripting interpreter Installation High
Detects the post-exploitation tail of CVE-2026-44789 — the n8n `node` process spawning a shell (`cmd.exe`, `sh`, `bash`, `powershell.exe`) or a LOLBin. Prototype-pollution RCEs land here because the polluted global lets the attacker reroute child-process spawning into arbitrary commands run as the n8n service account. Rationale: Uses the most reliable post-exploit signal — n8n's `node` process spawning a shell or LOLBin — which is the actual outcome chain described in GHSA-c8xv-5998-g76h ("combined with other techniques this could lead to RCE"). Article + Endor Labs corroboration both flag RCE as the impact, and CWE-1321 prototype-pollution chains universally land via hijacked child-process spawn. Cross-checked against: • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c8xv-5998-g76h • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-44789 • https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1321.html • https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1190/
ATT&CKT1059 T1059.001 T1059.004 T1190
Data sourcesEndpoint.Processes
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ShellsAndLolbins = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","sh","bash","zsh","dash","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","nc","ncat","socat"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe","node")
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("n8n", "\\n8n\\", "/n8n/")
   or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any ("n8n", "\\.n8n\\")
| where FileName in~ (ShellsAndLolbins)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ShellsAndLolbins = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","sh","bash","zsh","dash","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","nc","ncat","socat"]);
let WinHits = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where ParentProcessName has_any ("node.exe","node\\","\\node")
    | where tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]) in~ (ShellsAndLolbins)
    | where (CommandLine has_any ("n8n")) or (ParentProcessName has "n8n") or true
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Host=Computer, User=TargetUserName,
              ParentImage=ParentProcessName, ChildImage=NewProcessName,
              ChildCmd=CommandLine, Source="SecurityEvent";
let AsimHits = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ParentProcessName has_any ("node.exe","node")
    | where ActingProcessName has_any (ShellsAndLolbins) or TargetProcessName has_any (ShellsAndLolbins)
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Host=DvcHostname, User=ActorUsername,
              ParentImage=ParentProcessName, ChildImage=coalesce(TargetProcessName, ActingProcessName),
              ChildCmd=coalesce(TargetProcessCommandLine, ActingProcessCommandLine),
              Source="ImProcessCreate";
union isfuzzy=true WinHits, AsimHits
| order by TimeGenerated desc

[LLM] Vulnerable n8n versions in TVM inventory (CVE-2026-44789) Reconnaissance High
Surfaces hosts and software packages where n8n is installed at a version inside the CVE-2026-44789 vulnerable range (<1.123.43, 2.0.0-rc.0–2.20.6, 2.21.0–2.22.0). Pre-exploit asset visibility — without this UC the SOC is hunting blind for an attack surface they don't know they own. Rationale: Article explicitly enumerates vulnerable version ranges (npm:n8n <1.123.43; 2.0.0-rc.0–<2.20.7; 2.21.0–<2.22.1) — version-range matching against TVM inventory is the lowest-FP detection possible and the most operationally valuable pre-attack signal. Corroborated against the NVD CVE entry and the published patched versions. Cross-checked against: • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c8xv-5998-g76h • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-44789
ATT&CKT1592.002 T1190
Data sources
DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory
| where SoftwareName =~ "n8n" or SoftwareName has "n8n"
| extend Parts = split(SoftwareVersion, ".")
| extend Major = toint(Parts[0]), Minor = toint(Parts[1]), Patch = toint(Parts[2])
| extend Vulnerable = case(
    Major == 1 and (Minor < 123 or (Minor == 123 and Patch < 43)), "yes-1.x (<1.123.43)",
    Major == 2 and Minor >= 0 and Minor <= 19, strcat("yes-2.", tostring(Minor), " (<2.20.7)"),
    Major == 2 and Minor == 20 and Patch < 7, "yes-2.20.<7",
    Major == 2 and Minor == 21, "yes-2.21 (<2.22.1)",
    Major == 2 and Minor == 22 and Patch < 1, "yes-2.22.0",
    "no")
| where Vulnerable != "no"
| join kind=leftouter (DeviceInfo | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by DeviceId | project DeviceId, IsInternetFacing, OSPlatform) on DeviceId
| project DeviceName, DeviceId, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, Vulnerable, IsInternetFacing, OSPlatform
| order by IsInternetFacing desc, DeviceName asc
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where CveId =~ "CVE-2026-44789" or SoftwareName has "n8n"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion
| join kind=leftouter (DeviceInfo | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId | project DeviceId, IsInternetFacing, OSPlatform) on DeviceId
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, DeviceId, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion,
          CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate, IsInternetFacing, OSPlatform
| order by IsInternetFacing desc, DeviceName asc

// TVM tables are daily snapshots — pin a 1-day window so the engine
// partitions on Timestamp instead of scanning the full retention.
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where CveId in~ ("CVE-2026-44789")
| join kind=inner (DeviceInfo | where Timestamp > ago(1d)) on DeviceId
| project DeviceName, OSPlatform, CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate
| order by VulnerabilitySeverityLevel asc, DeviceName asc

// Sentinel has no native TVM table. If MDE→Sentinel streaming is enabled,
// `DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities` is available. Otherwise this UC has
// no Sentinel translation — track via Update / Heartbeat OS-version
// gaps as a coarse approximation.
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where CveId in~ ("CVE-2026-44789")
| join kind=inner (DeviceInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)) on DeviceId
| project DeviceName, OSPlatform, CveId,
          VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate
| order by VulnerabilitySeverityLevel asc, DeviceName asc

[LLM] Inbound exploit attempt to Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager from known UAT-8616 / Cluster IPs Exploitation High
Detects network connections from the Talos-published exploit-source IPs targeting Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager / vSmart (vManage) management interfaces. Anchors on the specific source IPs Talos attributes to UAT-8616 and Clusters 1-4 exploiting CVE-2026-20182 and the CVE-2026-20133/20128/20122 chain. Rationale: Source IPs are explicitly attributed by Talos to UAT-8616 (CVE-2026-20182) and Clusters 1-4 (CVE-2026-20133/20128/20122). Ports cover vManage HTTPS (443/8443), NETCONF (830), SD-WAN device control (4566), and SSH (22). Cross-checked with Cisco PSIRT advisory cisco-sa-sdwan-auth-bypass and Rapid7's disclosure referenced in the article. Cross-checked against: • https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/publicationListing.x • https://blog.talosintelligence.com/sd-wan-ongoing-exploitation/
ATT&CKT1190 T1133

[LLM] XenShell / Godzilla / Behinder JSP webshell file write on Cisco SD-WAN Manager Installation High
Detects creation of the specific JSP webshell filenames Talos observed dropped on compromised Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager nodes after exploitation of CVE-2026-20133/20128/20122. Filenames are non-generic and attacker-chosen (20251117022131.jsp, conf.jsp, sysv.jsp, sysinit.jsp, vmurnp_ikp.jsp). Rationale: Filenames 20251117022131.jsp, conf.jsp, sysv.jsp, sysinit.jsp, vmurnp_ikp.jsp are explicitly named by Talos as attacker-dropped XenShell/Godzilla/Behinder variants on the SD-WAN Manager. Generic .jsp creation under vManage webapps directories also catches XenShell variants with rotating names since SD-WAN Manager should not be receiving developer-dropped JSPs in production. Cross-checked against: • https://blog.talosintelligence.com/sd-wan-ongoing-exploitation/ • https://github.com/BeichenDream/Godzilla

[LLM] AdaptixC2 'shadowcore' / Mythic C2 traffic to UAT-8616 infrastructure 194.163.175.135 Command & Control High
Detects outbound traffic to the AdaptixC2/Mythic infrastructure Talos attributes to UAT-8616 — IP 194.163.175.135 hosting AdaptixC2 on port 4445 (banner renamed from 'AdapticC2 server' to 'shadowcore'), another AdaptixC2 listener on 31337, and a Mythic C2 listener on 7443 with certificate serial fece5b954e69b2c6a8d0a1029631a0d7. Rationale: 194.163.175.135 plus the trio of ports (4445 AdaptixC2 with 'shadowcore' banner, 7443 Mythic, 31337 second AdaptixC2 listener) and the Mythic cert serial fece5b954e69b2c6a8d0a1029631a0d7 are explicitly published by Talos as UAT-8616 infrastructure on Contabo GmbH. The IP-and-port tuple is high-fidelity because legitimate enterprise traffic to a Contabo VPS on these obscure ports is exceedingly rare. Cross-checked against: • https://blog.talosintelligence.com/sd-wan-ongoing-exploitation/ • https://github.com/Adaptix-Framework/AdaptixC2 • https://github.com/its-a-feature/Mythic

[LLM] AdaptixC2 'systemd-resolved' or Sliver 'CWan' implant on Linux / SD-WAN host Installation High
Detects the specific implant filenames Talos observed dropped post-exploitation on Cisco SD-WAN devices: 'systemd-resolved' (AdaptixC2 agent masquerading as the legitimate Linux service) calling 194.163.175.135:4445, and 'CWan' (Sliver implant) calling mtls://23.27.143.170:443. Hunts both the file presence and the C2 callouts. Rationale: Talos explicitly names the implant filenames ('systemd-resolved' for AdaptixC2 and 'CWan' for Sliver) and the C2 endpoints (194.163.175.135:4445, mtls://23.27.143.170:443). The masquerade check excludes the legitimate /lib/systemd path for systemd-resolved, so any other path equals a high-fidelity hit. Verified Sliver and AdaptixC2 framework attribution via the public AdaptixC2 and Sliver project pages. Cross-checked against: • https://blog.talosintelligence.com/sd-wan-ongoing-exploitation/ • https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver • https://github.com/Adaptix-Framework/AdaptixC2
ATT&CKT1036.005 T1059.004 T1071.001

(DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(60d)
  | where (FileName =~ "systemd-resolved" and FolderPath !in~ (ImpostorPaths))
     or FileName =~ "CWan"
     or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("194.163.175.135","23.27.143.170")
  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, AccountName),
(DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(60d)
  | where RemoteIP in (C2_IPs)
  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName)
| order by Timestamp desc

[LLM] UAT-8616 post-compromise on SD-WAN: SSH key add, NETCONF edit, su root, XMRig miner.sh Actions on Objectives High
Detects the specific post-compromise actions Talos lists for UAT-8616 after exploitation of CVE-2026-20182/20127 — adding SSH keys, modifying NETCONF configuration, privilege escalation via 'su root -c id', plus Cluster 7's XMRig deployment via /tmp/moneroocean/miner.sh with config_background.json. Rationale: Anchors directly on the article's verbatim strings: Code Block 2 (/tmp/moneroocean/miner.sh --config=/tmp/moneroocean/config_background.json), Code Block 3 (su root -c id), and the named post-compromise actions Talos lists for UAT-8616 (SSH key addition, NETCONF configuration modification). The 'su root -c id' command is a UAT-8616 fingerprint — a sophisticated actor verifying root context after privilege escalation, not normal admin usage. Cross-checked against: • https://blog.talosintelligence.com/sd-wan-ongoing-exploitation/ • https://moneroocean.stream/
ATT&CKT1098.004 T1543 T1548.003 T1496
Data sourcesEndpoint.Processes Endpoint.Filesystem
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(60d)
| where (ProcessCommandLine has "su root" and ProcessCommandLine has "-c" and ProcessCommandLine has "id")
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/tmp/moneroocean/miner.sh","config_background.json","moneroocean")
   or (ProcessCommandLine has "authorized_keys" and FileName in~ ("bash","sh","tee","echo","cat","dd","cp"))
   or (ProcessCommandLine has "edit-config" and ProcessCommandLine has "netconf")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessParentFileName
| order by Timestamp desc
let Keywords = dynamic(["su root -c id","su root \u2013c id","/tmp/moneroocean/miner.sh","config_background.json","moneroocean","authorized_keys","edit-config","netconf"]);
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(60d)
| where SyslogMessage has_any (Keywords)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, HostName, Facility, SeverityLevel, ProcessName, SyslogMessage
| order by TimeGenerated desc
source:(linux.auditd OR linux.syslog) (@process.command_line:(*"su root"*"-c"*id* OR *"/tmp/moneroocean/miner.sh"* OR *config_background.json* OR *moneroocean*) OR (@process.command_line:*authorized_keys* AND @process.name:(bash OR sh OR tee OR echo OR cat OR dd OR cp)) OR (@process.command_line:*edit-config* AND @process.command_line:*netconf*))
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 | (regex("su\\s+root\\s+-c\\s+id", field=CommandLine) OR regex("/tmp/moneroocean/miner\\.sh", field=CommandLine) OR regex("config_background\\.json", field=CommandLine) OR (regex("authorized_keys", field=CommandLine) AND ImageFileName=/\/(bash|sh|tee|echo|cat|dd|cp)$/i) OR (regex("edit-config", field=CommandLine) AND regex("netconf", field=CommandLine))) | groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())
ENDPOINT

Beaconing — periodic outbound to small set of destinations Command & Control Medium
C2 channel detection via inter-beacon-time stddev / fan-out to single dest.
ATT&CKT1071.001 T1071.004
Data sourcesNetwork_Traffic.All_Traffic DeviceNetworkEvents
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where RemoteIPType == "Public" and ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| project DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, Timestamp
| sort by DeviceName asc, RemoteIP asc, RemotePort asc, Timestamp asc
| extend prev_dev = prev(DeviceName, 1), prev_ip = prev(RemoteIP, 1),
         prev_port = prev(RemotePort, 1), prev_ts = prev(Timestamp, 1)
| where DeviceName == prev_dev and RemoteIP == prev_ip and RemotePort == prev_port
| extend delta_sec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, prev_ts)
| summarize conn_count = count(), avg_delta = avg(delta_sec), stdev_delta = stdev(delta_sec)
    by DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| where conn_count > 30 and avg_delta between (30.0 .. 600.0) and stdev_delta < 5.0
| order by conn_count desc
ImNetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
| where DvcAction != "Block"
| where ipv4_is_private(DstIpAddr) == false
| summarize ConnCount = count(),
            DistinctMinutes = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1m))
            by DvcHostname, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber
| where ConnCount > 50 and DistinctMinutes > 30   // sustained, not bursty
| order by ConnCount desc
NETWORK
Toggle if your env has no CIM data-model acceleration.
| tstats `summariesonly` count, values(All_Traffic.dest_port) AS ports
    from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic
    where All_Traffic.action="allowed" AND All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal"
    by _time span=10s, All_Traffic.src, All_Traffic.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
| streamstats current=f last(_time) AS prev_time by src, dest
| eval delta = _time - prev_time
| stats avg(delta) AS avg_delta stdev(delta) AS sd_delta count by src, dest
| where count > 30 AND sd_delta < 5 AND avg_delta>=30 AND avg_delta<=600
| sort - count
| tstats summariesonly=false count, values(All_Traffic.dest_port) AS ports
    from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic
    where All_Traffic.action="allowed" AND All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal"
    by _time span=10s, All_Traffic.src, All_Traffic.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
| streamstats current=f last(_time) AS prev_time by src, dest
| eval delta = _time - prev_time
| stats avg(delta) AS avg_delta stdev(delta) AS sd_delta count by src, dest
| where count > 30 AND sd_delta < 5 AND avg_delta>=30 AND avg_delta<=600
| sort - count

Asset exposure — vulnerability matches article CVE(s) Reconnaissance High
Match vulnerability scanner output to the CVE(s) named in the article.
ATT&CKT1190
Data sourcesVulnerabilities DeviceInfo DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
// TVM tables are daily snapshots — pin a 1-day window so the engine
// partitions on Timestamp instead of scanning the full retention.
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where CveId in~ ("CVE-2026-20182", "CVE-2026-20133", "CVE-2026-20128", "CVE-2026-20122", "CVE-2026-20127")
| join kind=inner (DeviceInfo | where Timestamp > ago(1d)) on DeviceId
| project DeviceName, OSPlatform, CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate
| order by VulnerabilitySeverityLevel asc, DeviceName asc

// Sentinel has no native TVM table. If MDE→Sentinel streaming is enabled,
// `DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities` is available. Otherwise this UC has
// no Sentinel translation — track via Update / Heartbeat OS-version
// gaps as a coarse approximation.
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where CveId in~ ("CVE-2026-20182", "CVE-2026-20133", "CVE-2026-20128", "CVE-2026-20122", "CVE-2026-20127")
| join kind=inner (DeviceInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)) on DeviceId
| project DeviceName, OSPlatform, CveId,
          VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate
| order by VulnerabilitySeverityLevel asc, DeviceName asc

Article-specific behavioural hunt — Ongoing exploitation of Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN vulnerabilities Exploitation High
Auto-generated hunt targeting the specific binaries, paths, registry locations and command-line fragments named in this article. Hunting tier — needs analyst review and environment tuning before promotion to alerting.
ATT&CKT1204.002
Data sourcesEndpoint.Processes Endpoint.Filesystem Endpoint.Registry
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Ongoing exploitation of Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN vulnerabilities
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("miner.sh", "loot_run.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/tmp/moneroocean/miner.sh", "/tmp/moneroocean/config_background.json", "/dev/null") or FileName in~ ("miner.sh", "loot_run.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
ENDPOINT

``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Ongoing exploitation of Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN vulnerabilities ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("miner.sh","loot_run.sh"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/moneroocean/miner.sh*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/moneroocean/config_background.json*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/dev/null*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("miner.sh","loot_run.sh"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
